# Keven Goulart

> Keven Goulart is a FullStack developer from Governador Valadares, Minas Gerais, Brazil, specialized in TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js and NestJS. He builds full-stack web applications on both the front-end and the back-end, focused on scalable and well-structured solutions, and has advanced proficiency in English. This is his portfolio: https://kezgoulart.dev

- Back-end: Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma, BullMQ

- Also: Shopify and Liquid

## Personal projects

- [Raio-X Público](https://github.com/KevenGoulart/Government-Tracking): platform to explore the public spending of Brazilian congresspeople from official open data. Turborepo monorepo with a Next.js front-end, a NestJS REST API (Swagger, Redis cache) and a NestJS + BullMQ worker that runs scheduled, idempotent ingestion jobs into PostgreSQL. Tested with Vitest, Supertest and Playwright + axe-core in GitHub Actions CI.
- [GeekLog](https://geeklog.app/): social network to review and share movies, TV shows, books and games with friends, with a website and an Android app. Turborepo monorepo with a Next.js website, a NestJS (Fastify) API and a React Native (Expo) Android app; MongoDB, Prisma, Redis, Socket.IO, Bull queues, AWS S3, Stripe, Prometheus and Grafana.
- [Cloth Showcase](https://cloth-showcase.vercel.app/) ([code](https://github.com/KevenGoulart/conversor-3d)): 3D fitting room that turns a photo of a garment into a piece dressed on a rigged 3D character. Next.js, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Drei and Blender Python scripts.
- [NFT Marketplace](https://nft-marketplace-theta-bay-72.vercel.app/) ([code](https://github.com/KevenGoulart/nft-marketplace)): front-end NFT marketplace with catalog, cart, checkout and real-time updates, with the whole API mocked in the browser with MSW. React, Vite, TanStack Router and Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Playwright.
- [More projects on GitHub](https://github.com/KevenGoulart?tab=repositories)

## Professional projects

- [Dra. Victoria](https://dravictoriabarbalho.com/): institutional landing page presenting a doctor, her services and areas of practice, focused on credibility and turning visitors into qualified contacts. Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Docker.
- Gold Ciclo: landing page promoting a vitamin supplement, presenting the product, its differentiators and composition. Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Docker. (currently offline)
- [Mais Vit](https://conheca.maisvit.com/): supplement online store built on Shopify, focused on a smooth shopping experience and conversion. Shopify, Liquid.
- [Libid365](https://www.libid365.com/): landing page promoting a vitamin supplement. Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Docker.
- UPSlim: web platform that manages user access to a subscription service for a weight loss method, with secure authentication, subscription management and exclusive content. Next.js, NestJS, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, Docker. (currently offline)
